senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (स्मरति)
1 To remember, to recollect, to call to mind.
2 To remember with regret, to miss.
r. 5th cl. (स्मृणोति)
1 To please or delight.
2 To guard, to protect, to cherish.
3 To breathe or live.
With वि prefixed,
To forget.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Recollected, remembered, called to mind.
E.
स्मृ to remember, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 Recollection, remembrance, memory.
2 Law, the body of law, as delivered originally by MANU, YĀJÑAVALKYA, and other inspired legislators, to their respective pupils, and committed by them from recollection to writing.
3 A law book, a code of laws.
4 Wish, desire.
5 Understanding.
E.
स्मृ to remember, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Remembering, recollecting, having a good memory.
E.
स्मृति memory, मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Illegal, unjust, contrary to law.
E.
स्मृति jurisprudence, and विरुद्ध opposed.

m. (-धः)
1 Opposition to law, illegality, impropriety.
2 Disagreement between two or more codes of law.
E.
स्मृति, and विरोध opposition.

n. (-स्त्रं)
A work on law, a code, a digest, &c. as the Menu Saṃhitā, the Mitākṣarā, &c.
E.
स्मृति law, and शास्त्र an inspired treatise.

m. (-तुः)
The proximate cause of recollection, the act of the mind by which any thing is called to memory, association, recollection.
E.
स्मृति memory, and हेतु cause.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Illegal, unjust.
2 Forgotten.
E.
स्मृति law, or memory, अप implying reverse, and इत gone.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Enjoined, prescribed, laid down in codes of law.
E.
स्मृति, and उक्त said.
